commonsFile: Forja artesanal. Yunque y fragua. Taller de Sergi Cadenas, en Gerona o Girona. Cataluña, España.jpg
author: CARLOS TEIXIDOR CADENAS
why: An artist-blacksmith shaping a red-hot piece on the anvil beside the forge in his own workshop: the hand forging at the heart of a metal art degree.
cropNote: Wide workshop interior; the centre crop keeps the smith, anvil and glowing forge together, no signage or logo.

author: Ian Schneider goian
why: A woodworker's hands smoothing a walnut board over a shaving-covered workshop floor: the hands-on making behind a wood-oriented furniture design degree.
cropNote: Landscape close-up; the centre crop keeps the hands and the board on the stool, no faces or text.

commonsFile: Woodworking with Hand Tools at the North House Folk School in Grand Marais, MN.jpg
author: Terasaface
why: A folk-school workbench laid out with chisels, saws and a half-made trestle part: the bench-and-hand-tool craft practice a craft degree is built on.
cropNote: Wide interior; the centre crop keeps the workbench, tools and frosted windows, the clock sits near the top edge, no people or logos.

author: Billkaboo
why: A string quartet rehearsing on a stage with scores on their stands: the ensemble work at the core of classical performance training.
cropNote: Landscape stage shot; the centre crop holds all four players and their instruments against the dark curtain, no text.

commonsFile: A rehearsal for the opera The Magic Flute in Tel Aviv (FL63494397).jpg
author: IPPA photographer
why: Papageno and Pamina rehearsing a scene of The Magic Flute on a staged set: singing and acting together, the craft an opera degree trains.
cropNote: Black-and-white landscape stage shot; the centre crop keeps both singers and the sun prop, the empty set at the edges takes the card veil.

commonsFile: Organist at Fifth Avenue Presbyterian Church (05382).jpg
author: Rhododendrites
why: An organist at a four-manual church organ console, hands on the keys and stops drawn: the church music and classical playing this music degree trains.
cropNote: Landscape interior; the centre crop keeps the player and the console's keyboards and stops, dark wood panelling at the edges, no text.

commonsFile: LRMC orthotists break the mold in patient care (6426345).jpg
author: Marcy Sanchez
why: Two orthotists drape heated thermoplastic over a plaster limb mould in a fabrication lab: making a custom orthosis, the hands-on core of prosthetics and orthotics.
cropNote: Landscape lab close-up; the centre crop keeps both technicians' hands and the mould, faces partly masked, no readable text.

author: David English
why: A boring bar cutting into a spinning workpiece on a lathe, curls of swarf flying: machining a part to tolerance, the workshop side of mechanical engineering.
cropNote: Close landscape shot; the centre crop keeps the chuck, workpiece and cutting tool, no people or text.

commonsFile: Modern warehouse with pallet rack storage system.jpg
author: Axisadman
why: A distribution warehouse floor of pallet racking, stacked goods and a forklift in the aisle: the flows of stock a supply chain management degree learns to plan.
cropNote: Wide high-angle interior; the centre crop keeps the racking rows and the pallets on the floor, no people prominent, no logos.

author: Geomartin
why: Copper-sulphide froth rising in a flotation cell at a working mine: mineral processing, the step that turns ore into metal concentrate, one of the core subjects of mineral resource engineering.
cropNote: Close landscape shot of bubbling grey froth; the centre crop is pure texture, no people, no text.

author: Mateus Figueiredo
why: Gloved hands pipetting culture medium from a flask of cancer cells inside a safety cabinet: the cell-biology bench work of a research-led biomedicine degree.
cropNote: Landscape close-up; the centre crop keeps both hands, the pipette and the red medium flask, no faces, no readable text.

author: Owlmonkey
why: A pipette loading a sample cell into a DNA sequencer: genome sequencing, one of the molecular tools a life science degree teaches.
cropNote: Landscape close-up; the centre crop keeps the pipette tip and the sequencing cell in its holder, no people, no text.

author: Johan Wessman / News Oresund
why: The NanoMAX experimental hutch at MAX IV, the synchrotron light source run by Lund University: the kind of large-scale physics instrument Lund physics students learn beside.
cropNote: Wide interior of the experiment hall; the centre crop keeps the orange hutch, racks and piping, a small beamline sign only, no people.

author: Dentren | Talk
why: A researcher kneeling by a clear gas-flux chamber on the Storflaket peat mire near Abisko, measuring methane from thawing permafrost: ecosystem science done in the field.
cropNote: Landscape field shot; the centre crop keeps the chamber and the mire with mountains behind, the researcher cut at the left edge, no text.

commonsFile: Wes Hildreth in the Long Valley Caldera.jpg
author: Emily Montgomery-Brown
why: A volcanologist sitting among rocks and sagebrush writing field notes in the Long Valley Caldera: reading the landscape on foot, the field side of earth science.
cropNote: Wide landscape; the centre crop keeps the geologist, the rock outcrop and the mountain skyline, no text.

author: NPS
why: A tape measure wrapped round a mossy trunk to record its girth: the tree measurement that underpins managing forests and planted landscapes.
cropNote: Close landscape detail; the centre crop keeps the tape's numbers and the bark texture, a hand at the lower edge, no faces.

author: Salima Ikram
why: An Egyptologist in dust mask and gloves working inside a rock-cut excavation in Egypt: the fieldwork that the study of ancient Egypt's language and remains leads to.
cropNote: Landscape shot in a rock chamber; the centre crop keeps the kneeling excavator and the limestone walls around her, no text.

author: Laboratório Criação Digital
why: A game-jam artist drawing a stylised dragon for a game on screen: making the 2D graphics a game is built from.
cropNote: Over-the-shoulder landscape; the centre crop keeps the monitor with the dragon artwork and the artist's headphones, no readable text.

author: Jan Dittrich (WMDE)
why: Hands sketching screen layouts on paper at a design workshop, a keyboard pushed aside: paper prototyping an interface before building it, a staple of interaction design.
cropNote: Top-down landscape close-up; the centre crop keeps the sketched screens and the drawing hand, no faces, handwriting too small to read.

author: Diliff
why: The European Parliament's hemicycle in Strasbourg filled for a plenary vote: European politics in session, the institutions a European studies degree examines.
cropNote: Very wide panorama; the centre crop keeps the tiered benches and the presidium, faces tiny, no readable signage.

commonsFile: Secretary Blinken Participates in UN Security Council Ministerial Meeting on Ukraine (54018355697).jpg
author: U.S. Department of State from United States
why: The UN Security Council in session round its horseshoe table beneath the Krohg mural: great-power diplomacy at work, the core subject of international relations.
cropNote: Landscape interior; the centre crop keeps the horseshoe table, delegations and mural, faces small, no readable nameplates.

author: Ziko van Dijk
why: Walls of card-index drawers at the Arolsen Archives, the largest record of Nazi persecution: the documents that Holocaust and genocide research is built on.
cropNote: Landscape interior; the centre crop keeps the wall of index drawers and the reading tables in front, exhibit panels at the edges, no faces.
